headline: ChatGPT advertising platform reaches 100k advertisers across 26 countries
body: OpenAI announced that over 100,000 advertisers are now using ChatGPT's ad platform, which recently expanded into 26 new countries and is now available on both Free and Go subscription tiers. For healthcare organizations, this signals ChatGPT's evolution from a consumer chatbot into a commercial distribution channel that vendors and healthcare systems may increasingly use for patient acquisition and provider recruitment. The rapid advertiser adoption raises important questions about how healthcare ads will be governed within AI interfaces, particularly around compliance with healthcare advertising regulations and patient privacy protections. Healthcare IT leaders should monitor how OpenAI handles sensitive healthcare advertising claims and whether healthcare-specific safeguards exist, as this platform could become a significant marketing channel that requires governance frameworks.
